dedupe_keys.name: atom activity based and agent based transport model of melbourne matsim melbourne

description: AToM (Activity-based and agent-based Transport model of Melbourne) is an open workflow for building a multi-modal agent-based and activity-based MATSim transport simulation of Greater Melbourne, with a detailed representation of walking and cycling alongside driving and public transport, and with mode choice calibrated for those four modes. Its synthetic population represents Melbourne's population from the 2016 Census, with daily activities and trips drawn from the Victorian travel survey (VISTA 2016-18), and its road network includes all public roads usable by the modelled modes, with active transport attributes. The authors compared outputs with observed mode shares, road volumes, travel times and distances. The code is published by RMIT University in the matsim-melbourne GitHub repositories: population generation in R (demand) and network generation in R with GDAL (network), both under the MIT licence. Coverage is regional (Greater Melbourne). Caveats: the population is a synthetic sample based on 2016 data, input data must be downloaded by the user following each repository's instructions, and running the simulation needs MATSim. The model supports agent-based studies of mode choice, road usage and network flow, and capacity planning for active transport infrastructure. It builds on MATSim.
inputs: road network with active transport attributes
